parts.text: Construct three candidate monospaced 18x20 bitmap fonts for the Gemini Supervisor reading-room cards. Historical inspiration should be High Middle Ages Germanic/Gothic scriptorium hands (early Gothic/Textura/book-hand traits), but machine-vision readability is the primary constraint. The cell geometry is fixed at exactly 18 pixels wide by 20 pixels high. Do not name existing fonts as the answer; construct usable pixel-font systems. Make candidate 1 the most OCR-safe, candidate 2 balanced, and candidate 3 the most strongly Gothic that still preserves reliable character separation. Return concrete machine-consumable JavaScript and representative exact 18x20 bitmaps. Ensure I/l/1, O/0, rn/m, c/e, braces/parentheses, quotes/backtick, slash/backslash, and Markdown/JSON/code punctuation remain visually distinct. Include a preview string that stresses those ambiguity pairs.
